metadata.title: पेसा के नाम पर पंचायत राज अधिनियम ना थोपे सरकार - वॉल्टर कंडुलना | Kandulna  Full Speech | PESA 1996
metadata.description:
In this powerful and eye-opening speech, noted tribal activist Walter Kandulna raises serious concerns about the implementation of the Provisions of the Panchayats (Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act, 1996 (PESA) in Jharkhand. Speaking at a recent workshop held in Ranchi, Kandulna alleges that the government is indirectly trying to impose the Jharkhand Panchayati Raj Act (JPRA) under the guise of implementing PESA.

Highlighting how this move threatens the autonomy of Gram Sabhas in Scheduled Areas, Kandulna calls for genuine implementation of PESA that respects tribal rights, traditions, and self-governance as guaranteed by the Constitution.

🔴 Watch the full speech to understand the ground reality of PESA in Jharkhand and why activists like Kandulna are sounding the alarm.

📌 Key issues discussed:

Difference between PESA and JPRA

Threats to Adivasi self-rule

Government's approach to tribal governance

Role of Gram Sabhas in protecting tribal rights
